_comment: Copy this to config.json inside your recording folder and edit. Tells the pipeline how to process this recording. See docs/SUITE2P_SETTINGS.md for how to pick native_fps.
_indicator_options: SRS9 jGCaMP8s (hSyn-jGCaMP8s) | SRS10 jGCaMP8f (hSyn-jGCaMP8f) | Fluo-4 AM (legacy dye). SRS11 = hSyn-ASAP4e-kV is a VOLTAGE sensor and is not handled by this pipeline. Construct names per Lentivirus transduction doc.
_native_fps_help: This recording's OWN true frame rate, read from the TIF timestamps (NOT the Suite2p GUI default). It changes every recording — set it each time; do not assume a fixed value per indicator.
_route_options: cascade_gc8s (jGCaMP8s -> CASCADE GC8s) | cascade_gc8f (jGCaMP8f -> CASCADE GC8f) | dff (Fluo-4 dye -> dF/F0 event detection, no CASCADE; legacy, retired going forward)
_route_help: You choose the FAMILY (by indicator), not a rate. run_cascade picks the pretrained model for that family and resamples this recording's data (from native_fps) to the model's rate automatically. CASCADE is GCaMP-only.
